must_catch.item: ACV is $95,000 per year, and the close does not list deal size as a gap
The tag is Value proof, and the report explicitly challenges 'lost on price'
The rep's 'more room on the rate' is labeled opinion and shown as contradicted
The declined decline analysis is surfaced
Rate-vs-rate (not total cost) on the CFO's page is identified

fails: The gaps insight says 'M6's independent ROI study and M8's customer stories were what we sent in its place.' The transcript says Sam sent only the deck (customer stories, average uplift) and the pricing proposal. No ROI study was sent; this is invented.
data.notes: The report correctly overturns 'lost on price': the CFO decided from a rate-only page where our only input was a quote. It also surfaces Lucy's unanswered business-case request and the skipped declines analysis, and its rep takeaway matches the key exactly. Its biggest miss is total cost: it never mentions the gateway fee or the full-time chargebacks person left off the controller's page, and its own business-case change still compares against 'the incumbent's rate'. It also invents an M6 ROI study as something we sent. The trigger insight misses that the pain belonged to someone who couldn't sign, and the opinion item passes only because 'We lost on price' is labeled opinion; the 'more room on the rate' line itself is never cited.
